## Problem

What user need or interoperability problem would this address?

## Proposed change

Describe the smallest useful behavior or API change.

## Compatibility and safety

Explain any format assumptions, limits, output-path implications, or
backward-compatibility concerns. Do not attach proprietary TI material or
downloaded third-party .tns files; use a synthetic fixture or a description
when possible.
